data.one_liner: Rich haptic feedback and vibration patterns for Flutter on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides 150+ built-in haptic presets, a pattern composer for custom sequences, and a realtime composer for gesture-driven feedback. It bridges a single Dart API to native CoreHaptics on iOS and the platform vibrator on Android.
use_when: You want to add expressive haptic feedback or vibration patterns to your app.
You need realtime control over haptic amplitude and frequency for sliders or gestures.
You want cross-platform haptics with iOS and Android platform-specific adaptations.
avoid_when: You only need basic, default system haptics already covered by standard Flutter services.
Your target devices lack vibration motors entirely and audio simulation is not enough.
strengths: Over 150 expressive built-in presets and system feedback types.
Pattern and realtime composers for custom haptic sequences.
Optional audio simulation to support devices with weaker motors.
weaknesses: Platform capabilities vary depending on device hardware support.
data.setup_notes: On Android, declare the VIBRATE permission in your AndroidManifest.xml.
